press_references.value: Notabene Flow Activates Hundreds of Customers, Enabling Stablecoin B2B Payments Across the Globe

product_launches.description: Notabene expanded its Notabene Flow stablecoin B2B payments network so that customers of hundreds of regulated digital asset institutions on the Notabene Network can now send and receive Flow payments directly from their existing hosted wallets with no extra integration or onboarding.

press_references.value: Notabene launches Revert to solve crypto's biggest gap: what happens after a transaction settles

product_launches.description: Notabene launched Revert, a post-settlement control layer that lets institutions coordinate, authorize, and track return-of-funds flows for settled crypto transactions across counterparties.

overview_description.description:
Notabene was founded to build SWIFT for Crypto. Notabene Transact, their core offering is now processing $5B of transactions a day between thousands of regulated institutions for purposes. 
They just launched Notabene Flow, the only B2B focused VisaNet like pull payment layer for stablecoins to their network. Notabene Flow allows their network members to offer better high margin B2B high margin services, such as recurring and agentic cross border B2B payments that no one has been able to solve at scale using stablecoins.

about_short_description.short_description: Notabene is the leading institutional transaction and payment messaging network for compliant stablecoin payments and crypto transactions

product.name: Notabene Transact
product.description: A pre-transaction compliance and authorization platform that automates Travel Rule data exchange, counterparty screening, self-hosted wallet identification, and risk-based approval of crypto transactions.

product.name: Notabene Flow
product.description: An API-driven stablecoin payments platform for business pay-ins, payouts, invoicing, and recurring payments, with counterparty verification and Travel Rule compliance built into settlement workflows.

product.name: Notabene Network
product.description: A network of verified virtual asset service providers that enables institutions to discover counterparties, assess reachability, exchange compliance data, and coordinate regulated crypto transactions globally.

product.name: Transaction Authorization Protocol (TAP)
product.description: An open protocol for exchanging secure pre-transaction messages that lets counterparties discover, validate, and authorize blockchain payments before funds move.

product.name: SafeConnect
product.description: An embeddable user interface for identifying and verifying Travel Rule counterparties, collecting required information, and proving ownership of self-hosted wallets during crypto transactions.

product.name: Regulatory Engagement and Compliance Intelligence
product.description: Regulatory guidance and jurisdiction-specific compliance information covering Travel Rule requirements, thresholds, enforcement status, counterparty obligations, and self-hosted wallet rules.
